_readme: Settings for the 'Real Stories' carousels. series_label is the small blue label on every slide. cta_text is the automatic 'send this' slide (put the part you want in blue inside [square brackets]). brand_slide is the very last slide: 'light' = your white follow-us slide, 'dark' = the same words on the dark design, 'off' = none. Its words come from content/cta.json. Edit freely - these files are safe to change on GitHub.
cta_text: Know someone who keeps going after a setback? [Send them this story.]
